blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Diocese of Tagum in Davao del Norte has urged the public to refrain from posting sexualized remarks about a “handsome” priest who recently went viral on Facebook. This came after the diocese greeted Fr. Christian Soronio on his first presbyteral anniversary in a Facebook post on Oct. 9. The post garnered over 9,000 likes, 900 comments and 2,000 shares. Most netizens congratulated Soronio on his achievement, while others commented on his physical appearance.
